'''Akira''' (Japanese: '''アキラ''' ''Akira'') is the main character of [[Pokémon Horizon]].

|desc={{p|Rockruff}} is Akira's only known Pokémon and partner. Rockruff has a unique ability to evolve into {{p|Lycanroc}} and then [[devolution|devolve]] into Rockruff again, thanks to the strange red stone on its neck. It also has the ability to change in between its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Lycanroc|Midday and Midnight Forms}} while being evolved.

While none of its [[move]]s are known, it can perform the [[Z-Move]] {{m|Breakneck Blitz}}.}}
